title: Guided emergency: symptom reported
fixed_sentence: Follow the onboard medical checklist and the crew medical officer.

steps.text: Safety: stop the current task and alert the crew.
Where: select the body zone where the symptom is felt.
Guided measurements, one at a time. Values are recorded as measured, without interpretation.

measures.how_to: Use the onboard device for heart rate and confirm the value shown on screen.
measures.why: NASA's Human Research Program reports that low gravity can alter the heart and blood vessels, and lists heart arrhythmias among the possible effects.

measures.how_to: Use the onboard device for blood pressure and confirm both values (SYS and DIA).
measures.why: NASA's Human Research Program lists low blood pressure, with a higher chance of fainting at landing, among the cardiovascular effects of spaceflight.

measures.how_to: Use the onboard device for body temperature and confirm the value shown on screen.
Use the onboard device for blood glucose and confirm the value shown on screen.

steps.text: Report: the report is generated from the recorded values only.
Send: the report is queued for the ground. The link status is shown on screen.
Log: record the human decision (accepted or rejected) and the time.
